comments.author: jayohh
comments.body_html:
Yes, I will. In the meantime, you can enable the items for the Special Slots yourself.

Navigate to:

C:\SPT\SPT\user\mods\Painter\db\CustomItems

Open the JSON file and find the item you want to edit and find the line containing "handbookPriceRoubles".

Important: Add a comma (,) after the "handbookPriceRoubles" value before adding the new property. If you forget the comma, the JSON will be invalid and SPT will fail to load the file.

Then add:

"addtoSpecialSlots": true

directly below the "handbookPriceRoubles" line.

Save the file and restart SPT for the changes to take effect.
